coaching.headline: A dominant 23-minute win: seven fights won, zero lost, towers finished nine to one.
coaching.team: Three of five lanes carried a pre-game unfavored tag and none of it mattered. First blood went to Zarus on Yin at 5.3, and we won every fight we took: seven skirmishes, seven wins, four tagged game-defining as towers fell. Their only tower came at 13.7, in a fight we won 2-1 while taking Mini Prime across the map. Yin's 12,472 hero damage was the enemy's biggest number, and only one of five of us itemized armor -- a gap the scoreline buried. Towers finished nine to one, objective damage 57,761 to 3,137.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 14.4-minute fight at their Outer Tower, won 4-0 by three of us against four of their five, started the rout. Three more skirmishes followed, all three tagged game-defining, and we never lost a fight the rest of the game.
coaching.whatWorked: Seven fights, seven wins, six cashed into towers or camps -- twice while outnumbered two-on-three (19.4 and 22.3) and the exchange still went our way.

focus.title: Winning the ward count, losing the ward war
focus.evidence: We placed 36 wards to their 24, but they destroyed 8 of ours while we destroyed just 1 of theirs -- a gap that didn't matter in a game this lopsided.
focus.action: Dedicate someone to hunting enemy wards, not just placing ours, so a vision lead isn't given away for free the next time the game is close.

synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
ourKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

ourKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
ourKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
ourKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
enemyKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

kira.loadout: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point), augment Siphoning Purge, crest Pacifier
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 23 minutes, fewer deaths than about 98% of Kira carry players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Purge at top rank: 105s base, about 80.8s by the end (23% shorter) from 30 ability haste: Ruination 10, Nuclear Rounds 20.
Kira dealt 18,335 hero damage, 29% of their team's, with +117 physical power from items.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Ruination (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Apply a bleed that drains Mana by 30 (+8% Target's Max Mana) over 4s. Deals True Damage equal to 80% of the Mana Drained.
Nuclear Rounds (item): Based on Critical Strike Chance: Increase Ability Damage by 10-20%.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
Siphoning Purge (augment): Purge Heals for 25% of its damage dealt to Heroes.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; 2,033 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Ruination, Vermis.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Pacifier, Siphoning Purge.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Kira killed built physical armor. No anti-heal on the team against a build that heals. We killed Kira 0 times.
Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 46.2% in 878 Kira carry games, below the hero's 49.4%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
